design.title: UVH v0.2.19 - RELATIONSHIP CLASS METADATA
design.permitted_game_instance_access: Only existing metadata preflight obj.Class and function binding/args._type; no game-field payload
design.gate_scope: Accepted98-operation known-name metadata plan only; no added uncounted function/return recheck
design.coverage_meaning: COMPLETE_LINK only means null-terminated scoped PropertyLink walk and checked descriptors; no exhaustive game-field or semantic ownership claim
design.callbacks_after_first_attempt: Exact None without metadata/payload getters; bounded primitive ignored/reentry counters with saturation flags
design.logging: After collecting frame/native locals/exceptions released and obj/args/func/ret dropped; primitives only, no row reread/retry
design.cleanup: Sample completion is inert with hook still present; explicit STOP/CANCEL/disable resolves owned/uncertain handles, busy STOP defers, no automatic rearm

grammar.format: compact sorted-key JSON after exact prefix; duplicate/extra keys, bool integers and unknown types rejected
strict_bounds_and_counter_relations: At most one START and metadata BEGIN/attempt per epoch, no ROW/ROOT before BEGIN
MGR then CTRL roots; row ordinals consecutive 1..64 per root; owner index0..2 MGR,0..6 CTRL
Known decl token does not identify a game owner; name ASCII1..128; scalar iff dimension1; size4 for row
ROOT visited0..512, objects<=visited, other<=objects, unsupported<=visited-objects, rows<=objects-other and<=64, rechecked<=visited
COMPLETE_LINK requires NONE reason, rechecked==visited, no bound/refusal; PARTIAL requires PROPERTY_LIMIT or ROW_LIMIT and completed rechecks
A schema/link/type/owner/range/cycle/duplicate/ABI/clock/time/budget/reentry failure produces REFUSED and no unvalidated rows
END total_ops equals four stage sums and<=28208; root ops<=96, gate<=112, catalogs<=14000 each; rows=sum root rows
Full successful gate98 and root68 operations; complete catalog ops=24*non_objects+27*exact_objects, transcript-verified in later implementation
END NOT_OBSERVED iff attempts0; completion requires two COMPLETE_LINK roots/no failures; any partial root preserves PARTIAL; any refusal preserves REFUSED
START handles1; sample END does not prove removal; STOP remaining/uncertain each0..1 with prior failure counts nondecreasing
Reentry/ignored counters saturate at64 with explicit saturation Boolean; no native generation inferred from counters
Cleanup failures/removal attempts<=256 per session; faults<=8 and control-family records<=64; extra control calls cannot append unbounded records
Failed registration, unowned identifiers and uncertain removals prevent new START; prior refusal/failure remains after resolved STOP
Mixed/clipped/unknown new or legacy markers rejected; limit excess invalid; native/effect readiness always false
